description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] After admission, constitute the warm magistrate or receive its authenticated return. Do not send a ruling. Workers cannot seal. Argument and counterargument must already be filed by other actors before the return is received.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.
